title: Prince Hans-Adam of Liechtenstein's letter: proof always slipped through his fingers
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Prince Hans-Adam of Liechtenstein's letter: proof always slipped through his fingers, about recent at Liechtenstein, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: apparently he wrote a very thoughtful letter back to to Max who who wrote to him

plain: Hans-Adam II is the prince who rules Liechtenstein, a small country in Europe. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the prince wrote a thoughtful letter back to a man named Max who had written to him, a story tied to the physicist Hal Puthoff, in which the prince said that proof about UFOs always slipped through his fingers. If true, it would mean even a head of state looked for answers and could not get them.
